reviewText: Best place in Jalandhar to buy bags! Bought an American Tourister trolley for my Dubai trip at a price way below online. Sethi sir personally helped me pick the right size. Truly trustworthy.
Excellent collection of ladies handbags. Got a beautiful Genie handbag with original tag. Quality is amazing and the staff is very polite and helpful.
Bought an Arctic Fox laptop backpack here for my office. Super comfortable and the discount they gave was unbeatable. Highly recommend!
Good variety of school bags. My son loved the Safari backpack. Reasonable prices and genuine branded products.
Been buying luggage from Sethi Purse for over 10 years. Never disappointed — original products and the best prices in Punjab.
